assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: For DIA: after each full-scan MS1... 16 x 25 m/z isolations windows in the 425–825 m/z range were sequentially isolated and subjected to MS/MS
labeling: Selected peptides were synthesized with stable isotopes (carboxy-terminal Arg (13C6; 15N4) or Lys (13C6; 15N2)) as AQUA™ peptides.
quantification: determined the subunit stoichiometry of the complex using the gold-standard absolute quantification (AQUA) strategy in combination with data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry (DIA-MS)
enrichment: Covalent cross-linking combined with mass spectrometry (XLMS)
Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs two distinct proteomics workflows: one for absolute stoichiometry using DIA-MS with AQUA peptides, and another for structural mapping using XLMS (DDA). Given the priority for routing, the DIA-MS and XLMS (complexome/structural) signals are primary. The XLMS uses multiple crosslinkers (DSS, BS3, ADH, DMTMM).

scope: we have used structural, biophysical, and biochemical data to define the architecture of the native NuRD complex purified from murine erythroleukemia (MEL) cells
Samples of NuDe and NuRD were isolated by FOG1 affinity pulldown from cultured mouse erythroleukemia (MEL) cells
For protein purification by FLAG-affinity pulldown, cells were resuspended in lysis buffer
Natively-purified NuRD, and four recombinantly-expressed NuRD subcomplexes, and a PWWP2A-MTA-HDAC-RBBP alternative ‘NuRD-like’ complex were subjected to crosslinking
subcellular_fraction: MEL cell nuclear extracts were prepared by incubating the thawed cell pellets with hypotonic lysis buffer
Nuclei were recovered via centrifugation at 3,300 g × 5 min.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of affinity-purified NuRD/NuDe complexes and recombinant subcomplexes. The native complexes were specifically purified from nuclear extracts of MEL cells.

evidence: We present an integrated analysis of the native mammalian NuRD complex, combining quantitative mass spectrometry, cross-linking, protein biochemistry, and electron microscopy to define the architecture of the complex.

replicate_hints: For every biological replicate that was analyzed, 1–2 replicates of DDA runs and 3–5 replicates of DIA runs were performed.
evidence: For every biological replicate that was analyzed, 1–2 replicates of DDA runs and 3–5 replicates of DIA runs were performed.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is a structural and stoichiometric characterization of the NuRD complex and its subcomplexes using DIA-MS and XLMS. It is not a perturbation or differential proteomics study; therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
